text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali presides over Consultative Council in charge of following up social dialogue.
- Crown Prince Mohamed inaugurates launch of new domestic carrier, Regional Air Lines.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri visits Algeciras to check transiting conditions for Moroccan expatriates returning home for summer.
- Police arrest two people with 46 kg (101.2 pounds) of gold and 716,000 dirhams ($18,526 dirhams) hidden in their car in the northern city of Nador.
- Morocco requests Japan's expertise to supply fishing villages with modern techniques and ways to preserve quality of products.
